comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
This historical event of the 15th Century (5th period) is one of the few adventure-type events and has arrived on Maris for what I believe is the first time. To participate, you have to register for the ship race and sail from Seville to San Juan.... in a medium/standard-class ship. About 20 times or so.

Well. Do have fun with that. Noteworthy rewards for racing enough times:

Wanderer of the Ages Hat / Pioneer of History - (unlocked at the same time; title must be picked up from a certain NPC)
Traveler's Treasure Box - final reward

Cheers.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?WorldClock%2FRace

wiki:
Event Type: Ship Race (medium/standard class ships only)
Route: Seville to San Juan

Details: Talk to any port official/guide in Seville, click Race Information button, choose Join option (1,000 ducats to register) and set sail when you are ready. The timer begins at sea and ends when you speak to the San Juan port official.

Each completed trip counts as progress for your nation in the historical event and can unlock rewards (sent to bank; use Receive Item button to retrieve them when ready). You do not have to be in the top 10 to receive the rewards listed below.

NOTE: If any member of your fleet is in a non-medium/standard class ship, or if you swap from a medium/standard class ship to a different type of ship, your participation in the race will automatically be canceled. No fair cheating!

Rewards:

1 trip - Headache Medication x3
? trips - Silver Tarot x3
? trips - Change Expedition Destination Ticket x3
? trips - Shipwreck Map Piece x3
? trips - Improved Gallant Staysail
? trips - Wanderer of the Ages Hat + Pioneer of History Title (if not yet unlocked)
? trips - Traveler's Treasure Box
